content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to control a [product_name] [version_no] over LAN using an Internet browser or a Visual Basic application? For instance, I want to read a counter value or set an output (Q). I have the IP address of the controller—how do I access these parameters? Regards, [user_name]

You can control the [product_name] [version_no] with a Visual Basic application. To do this, you'll need to use PC access software for [version_no] controllers, which provides an OPC-Server for communication with the device. More information about this software can be found at [url].
Thank you! Is it also possible to use an Internet browser, Java, or other methods for access?

Hi, The [product_name] does not include a web server. Here are some options: 1. If you use an HMI panel with the controller, you can utilize the web server from the panel. 2. For Android devices, there's an app that supports basic communication; a free version is available. 3. As mentioned earlier, using an OPC-Server is another option for working with the [product_name] [version_no]. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for ways to remotely access and control a [product_name] [version_no] via LAN, preferably through standard methods like Internet browsers or Visual Basic applications. The key insight is that the device does not have a built-in web server, so direct browser access is not supported. Users need to rely on dedicated software like OPC-Servers or additional hardware, such as HMI panels, for remote interaction.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple method to monitor and control a [product_name] [version_no] remotely using a browser or customized applications such as Visual Basic, seeking an easy-to-use, programmatic or web-based interface.
